ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - F-Secure C3 Load by Rundll32
ruleDefinitions.description: F-Secure C3 produces DLLs with a default exported StartNodeRelay function.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32\\\.exe.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*StartNodeRelay.*"))
